summary_en: 350,000 ordinary shares cancelled effective 2026-06-30 pursuant to Companies Act Article 178 (2.1% of pre-cancellation S/O). Post-cancellation issued shares: 16,179,700.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Asahi Information Services (ticker 9799, TSE Standard) completed the cancellation of 350,000 ordinary treasury shares on 30 June 2026 pursuant to a board resolution dated 5 November 2025 under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation represented 2.1% of issued shares outstanding before the cancellation. Following completion, total issued shares (excluding treasury) stand at 16,179,700.
